hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In each step find the maximum element currently in the unsorted prefix.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Flip the prefix to bring this maximum element to the first position.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Flip the entire unsorted prefix to place this element at its final correct suffix index.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def pancakeSort(arr: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    ans = []
    n = len(arr)
    a = list(arr)
    for target in range(n, 1, -1):
        idx = a.index(target)
        if idx == target - 1:
            continue
        if idx != 0:
            ans.append(idx + 1)
            a[:idx + 1] = reversed(a[:idx + 1])
        ans.append(target)
        a[:target] = reversed(a[:target])
    return ans
```
